column3: NASB supplies “a possession” twice and “the one” and “the other”; “So when” renders “and also when.”
“returned home” renders “returned”; “according to the command of the LORD through Moses” renders “on the mouth of the LORD by the hand of Moses.”
“the region of the Jordan” renders “Geliloth of the Jordan.”
“at the frontier of” renders “opposite”; “the region of the Jordan” renders “Geliloth of the Jordan.”
“chiefs” renders “leaders”; “the thousands of Israel” renders a word that also means “clans.”
“Is not … enough for us” renders “Is it too little for us”; “although” renders “and.”
“the Lord’s tabernacle” uses a lowercase “Lord” for “Yahweh”; “stands” renders “dwells.”
“wrath fall” renders “wrath was”; “did not perish alone” renders the question “he was one man; did he not die?”
“The Mighty One, God, the LORD” renders “El, Elohim, Yahweh.”
“If we have built” renders “To build”; NASB supplies “we have.”
“truly” renders “if not”; “out of concern, for a reason” renders “from anxiety, from a matter,” and “sons” renders “descendants.”
“Let us build” renders “Let us act … by building.”
“it pleased them” renders “it was good in their eyes.”
